legend: Xenia likes puzzles very much. She is especially fond of the puzzles that consist of domino pieces. Look at the picture that shows one of such puzzles.
A puzzle is a 3 × n table with forbidden cells (black squares) containing dominoes (colored rectangles on the picture). A puzzle is called correct if it meets the following conditions:
each domino occupies exactly two non-forbidden cells of the table;
no two dominoes occupy the same table cell;
exactly one non-forbidden cell of the table is unoccupied by any domino (it is marked by a circle in the picture).

To solve the puzzle, you need multiple steps to transport an empty cell from the starting position to some specified position. A move is transporting a domino to the empty cell, provided that the puzzle stays correct. The horizontal dominoes can be moved only horizontally, and vertical dominoes can be moved only vertically. You can't rotate dominoes. The picture shows a probable move.

Xenia has a 3 × n table with forbidden cells and a cell marked with a circle. Also, Xenia has very many identical dominoes. Now Xenia is wondering, how many distinct correct puzzles she can make if she puts dominoes on the existing table. Also, Xenia wants the circle-marked cell to be empty in the resulting puzzle. The puzzle must contain at least one move.
Help Xenia, count the described number of puzzles. As the described number can be rather large, print the remainder after dividing it by 1000000007 (109 + 7).
input: The first line contains integer n (3 ≤ n ≤ 104) — the puzzle's size. Each of the following three lines contains n characters — the description of the table. The j-th character of the i-th line equals "X" if the corresponding cell is forbidden; it equals ".", if the corresponding cell is non-forbidden and "O", if the corresponding cell is marked with a circle.
It is guaranteed that exactly one cell in the table is marked with a circle. It is guaranteed that all cells of a given table having at least one common point with the marked cell is non-forbidden.
output: Print a single number — the answer to the problem modulo 1000000007 (109 + 7).
note: Two puzzles are considered distinct if there is a pair of cells that contain one domino in one puzzle and do not contain it in the other one.

legend.ai: Xenia 非常喜欢谜题。她尤其喜欢由多米诺骨牌组成的谜题。请看展示了其中一个谜题的图片。
一个谜题是一个 3 × n 的表格，其中有禁用单元格（黑色方格），并放置着多米诺骨牌（图中的彩色矩形）。如果一个谜题满足以下条件，则称其为正确：
每块多米诺骨牌恰好占据表格中的两个非禁用单元格；
没有两个多米诺骨牌占据同一个表格单元格；
表格中恰好有一个非禁用单元格未被任何多米诺骨牌占据（图中用圆圈标出）。
为了完成这个谜题，你需要经过多步操作，将一个空单元格从起始位置移动到某个指定位置。一次移动是将一个多米诺骨牌移到空单元格处，前提是移动后谜题仍然正确。横向多米诺骨牌只能水平移动，竖向多米诺骨牌只能竖直移动。你不能旋转多米诺骨牌。图中展示了一种可能的移动。
Xenia 有一个带有禁用单元格和一个圆圈标记单元格的 3×n 表格。此外，Xenia 还有许多完全相同的多米诺骨牌。现在，Xenia 想知道，如果将多米诺骨牌放在已有的表格上，她可以组成多少种不同的正确谜题。此外，Xenia 希望在最终谜题中，圆圈标记的单元格为空。谜题中至少必须存在一次移动。
请帮助 Xenia，计算上述谜题的数量。由于这个数量可能很大，请输出它除以 1000000007（10^9+7）所得的余数。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 n（3≤n≤10^4）——谜题的大小。接下来的三行每行包含 n 个字符，表示表格。第 i 行第 j 个字符如果为“X”，则表示对应的单元格是禁用的；如果为“.”，则表示对应的单元格是非禁用的；如果为“O”，则表示对应的单元格被圆圈标记。
保证表格中恰有一个单元格被圆圈标记。保证给定表格中所有与被标记单元格至少有一个公共点的单元格都不是禁用的。

output.ai: 输出一个数——问题答案对 1000000007（10^9 + 7）取模的结果。

note.ai: 如果存在一对单元格，使得其中一个拼图中有一块多米诺骨牌覆盖着这两个单元格，而另一个拼图中没有，则认为这两个拼图不同。
